lessons.title: Healthy habits
lessons.goal_uz: Sog'lom turmush tarzi haqida gapirasiz va should / shouldn't / ought to bilan maslahat berasiz.

words.ex: Drinking water in the morning is a good habit.
A balanced diet includes fruit and vegetables.
Teenagers often eat too much junk food.
You should get enough sleep before an exam.
I feel stressed when I have too much work.
I'm trying to cut down on sugar.
She works out three times a week.
Too much screen time is bad for your eyes.

steps.title: I'm always tired!
steps.context_uz: Diyora doim charchaganidan shikoyat qiladi, dugonasi Emma unga maslahat bermoqda.

lines.en: I don't know what's wrong with me. I'm always tired these days.
lines.uz: Menga nima bo'lganini bilmayman. Shu kunlarda doim charchaganman.

lines.en: How much sleep do you usually get?
About five hours. I watch videos on my phone until two in the morning.
lines.uz: Taxminan besh soat. Tungi soat ikkigacha telefonda video ko'raman.

lines.en: Well, that's the problem! You should put your phone away an hour before bed.
lines.uz: Mana muammo! Uxlashdan bir soat oldin telefoningni chetga qo'yishing kerak.

lines.en: You're right. I also drink a lot of coffee to stay awake.
lines.uz: To'g'ri aytasan. Uyg'oq turish uchun ko'p qahva ham ichaman.

lines.en: You shouldn't drink coffee after lunch. And maybe you ought to work out a bit — exercise gives you energy.
lines.uz: Tushlikdan keyin qahva ichmaganing ma'qul. Balki biroz sport bilan shug'ullanishing kerakdir — mashq quvvat beradi.

lines.en: OK, I'll try. Thanks for the advice!
lines.uz: Xo'p, harakat qilaman. Maslahating uchun rahmat!

options: She doesn't sleep enough because of her phone.
steps.explain_uz: U tungi soat ikkigacha telefonda video ko'radi va atigi 5 soat uxlaydi.

steps.q: What does Emma say about coffee?
options: Diyora shouldn't drink it after lunch.

steps.body_uz:
Maslahat berish uchun: **should + fe'l** (kerak, ma'qul) · **shouldn't + fe'l** (kerak emas) · **ought to + fe'l** (should bilan bir xil, biroz rasmiyroq).
should'dan keyin **to qo'yilmaydi** va fe'lga **-s qo'shilmaydi**: She **should sleep** more. ("She should to sleep" / "She should sleeps" — xato!)
So'rash: **Should I** see a doctor? · **What should I do?**
Yumshoq maslahat: **Why don't you** go for a walk? · **If I were you, I'd** eat less sugar.

examples.en: He shouldn't eat so much junk food.
examples.uz: U buncha ko'p fast-fud yemasligi kerak.

examples.en: If I were you, I'd go to bed earlier.

steps.prompt_uz: Do'stingiz imtihon oldidan juda stressda va yaxshi uxlay olmayapti. Unga 5–6 gapda maslahat yozing (should, shouldn't, ought to, Why don't you...).
steps.prompt: Your friend is stressed before an exam and can't sleep well. Write some advice.
steps.example: I'm sorry you feel so stressed. First, you shouldn't study late at night — your brain needs rest. You should go to bed at the same time every day. Why don't you go for a short walk after dinner? It really helps me relax. You also ought to cut down on coffee. And if I were you, I'd make a simple study plan, so you don't worry about everything at once.

steps.title: A visit to the GP
steps.context_uz: Bekzod Londonda o'qiydi va umumiy amaliyot shifokoriga (GP) murojaat qildi.

lines.en: Good morning. Please take a seat. What seems to be the problem?
lines.uz: Xayrli tong. O'tiring. Sizni nima bezovta qilyapti?

lines.en: I've got a sore throat and a bad cough.
I see. How long have you had these symptoms?
lines.uz: Tushunarli. Bu belgilar qachondan beri bor?

lines.en: I've had the cough for about a week, and my throat has hurt since Monday.
lines.uz: Yo'tal taxminan bir haftadan beri, tomog'im esa dushanbadan beri og'riyapti.

lines.en: Yes, a little. It was thirty-seven point eight last night.
It looks like a throat infection. I'll give you a prescription. Take one tablet twice a day, and drink plenty of warm liquids.
lines.uz: Tomoq infeksiyasiga o'xshaydi. Sizga retsept yozib beraman. Kuniga ikki marta bittadan tabletka iching va ko'p iliq suyuqlik iching.

lines.en: Thank you, doctor. Should I stay at home?
Yes, rest for two or three days. If you don't feel better, make another appointment.
lines.uz: Ha, ikki-uch kun dam oling. Yaxshi bo'lmasangiz, yana qabulga yoziling.

steps.title_uz: Qancha vaqtdan beri? Present Perfect + for / since
steps.body_uz:
O'tmishda boshlanib, **hozir ham davom etayotgan** holat uchun o'zbekcha "...dan beri og'riyapti" deymiz. Ingliz tilida bu yerda Present Simple emas, **Present Perfect** ishlatiladi:
I **have had** a headache **for** two days. ("I have a headache since two days" — o'zbeklarning eng ko'p xatosi!)
**for** + davomiylik: for two days, for a week, for ages.
**since** + boshlanish nuqtasi: since Monday, since 2020, since I was a child.
So'roq: **How long have you had** this pain?
Kasallikni aytish: I**'ve got** a cold / a headache / a temperature · My leg **hurts**.

lessons.title: Getting fit
lessons.goal_uz: Sport odatlaringiz haqida gapirasiz: enjoy doing / decide to do va used to bilan oldin va hozirni solishtirasiz.

words.ex: I want to get fit before the summer.
She goes to the gym after work.
I used to play football every day.
He gave up smoking last year.
My dad took up swimming at fifty.
Swimming is good for all your muscles.
She lost five kilos in two months.
It's easier to stay motivated with a friend.

steps.title: From sofa to 10K
steps.text: Two years ago, I was not a sporty person at all. I used to spend every evening on the sofa, and I didn't use to walk anywhere — I took a taxi even for short distances. Then one day I couldn't climb the stairs to my office without stopping, and I decided to change. I took up running with an app for beginners. At first, I hated running for more than two minutes! But I kept going, and slowly I started to enjoy being outside. A friend joined me, which helped me stay motivated. Last month I finished my first ten-kilometre race. I've lost eight kilos, I sleep better, and I've given up fizzy drinks completely.
steps.uz: Ikki yil oldin men umuman sportchi emas edim. Har kechqurunni divanda o'tkazardim va hech qayerga piyoda yurmasdim — yaqin masofaga ham taksi olardim. Keyin bir kuni ofisimga zinadan to'xtamay chiqa olmadim va o'zgarishga qaror qildim. Yangi boshlovchilar uchun ilova bilan yugurishni boshladim. Avvaliga ikki daqiqadan ko'p yugurishni yomon ko'rardim! Lekin davom etaverdim va asta-sekin tashqarida bo'lish menga yoqa boshladi. Bir do'stim menga qo'shildi, bu ishtiyoqimni saqlashga yordam berdi. O'tgan oy birinchi o'n kilometrlik yugurishimni tugatdim. Sakkiz kilo vazn yo'qotdim, yaxshiroq uxlayman va gazli ichimliklarni butunlay tashladim.

steps.q: What made the writer decide to change?
options: He couldn't climb the stairs without stopping.
steps.explain_uz: "I couldn't climb the stairs to my office without stopping, and I decided to change."
"A friend joined me, which helped me stay motivated."

steps.body_uz:
**used to + fe'l** — ilgari odat bo'lgan, hozir esa yo'q: I **used to play** football. (Hozir o'ynamayman.)
Inkor/so'roq: I **didn't use to** walk. · **Did** you **use to** do sport? (did'dan keyin **use**, "used" emas!)
**Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin -ing keladi:** enjoy, like/love, hate, finish, give up, keep, stop + **doing**: I enjoy **running**. He gave up **smoking**.
**Ba'zilaridan keyin to + fe'l:** decide, want, hope, plan, try, learn + **to do**: I decided **to change**. She wants **to lose** weight.
Predlogdan keyin har doim **-ing**: I'm good at **swimming**. · Thanks for **helping**.
